name: mcp-microsoft
description: Mail, Calendar, OneDrive, and SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API for personal and enterprise accounts with multi-profile support
long_description:
Full Microsoft 365 integration for Claude Desktop. Manage emails, drafts, calendar events, OneDrive files, and SharePoint sites across multiple accounts (personal Outlook.com/Live and enterprise Azure AD/Entra). Supports multi-profile authentication so you can switch between work and personal accounts seamlessly.

**56 tools** covering:
- **Mail**: Read, send, reply, forward, search, move, and manage emails
- **Drafts**: Create, update, and send draft messages
- **Calendar**: Events, scheduling, free/busy lookups, and meeting time suggestions
- **OneDrive**: Browse, upload, download, search, and manage files
- **SharePoint**: Browse sites, document libraries, upload/download files, and manage SharePoint lists (work accounts only)
- **Profiles**: Add and switch between multiple Microsoft 365 accounts
